name: Midland County, TX
findings: Midland County has 489 nonprofit organizations. 189 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 144 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Midland County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 15 professional organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 45 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
